architectural_units.name: TypeScript
architectural_units.description: Programming language used for the development of the System Service.
Traefik manages the routing of HTTP and HTTPS requests to the Next.js application (System Service).
The System Service communicates with the PostgreSQL database (Data Service) using Prisma as an ORM.
The System Service interacts with Google for user authentication.
The System Service interacts with Amazon S3 to store and retrieve files.
The System Service integrates with Stripe to handle payments and subscriptions.
The System Service implements Google Analytics to track and analyze site traffic.
The System Service uses Sentry to track and manage errors in the application.
The System Service connects to Brevo to create, send, and schedule emails.
